summary: The filing is a Form 8-K by Brookfield Private Equity Fund LP reporting unregistered sales of limited partnership units in its continuous private offering, totaling approximately $16.959 million on July 1, 2026. It also discloses transactional NAV per unit for each class as of June 30, 2026. These are routine operational disclosures under Items 3.02 and 8.01 for a continuously offering fund, with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, restructuring, or strategic review. The sales are exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D, reflecting normal capital-raising activities.
